summary.title: PBM Claims Processing Platform
summary.description: Threat model for the pharmacy benefit management claims processing pipeline covering web client, API gateway, and member database tiers.

data.name: Web Client
data.description: Pharmacy operator browser accessing the PBM claims portal.

threats.title: Pharmacy credential theft via phishing
threats.description: An attacker may obtain pharmacy operator credentials through phishing, enabling unauthorized claims submission under a legitimate pharmacy identity.
threats.mitigation: Enforce MFA for all pharmacy operator logins; implement FIDO2 tokens for high-privilege accounts; rotate credentials quarterly.

threats.title: Session token replay from XSS
threats.description: Reflected or stored XSS in the claims portal could allow an attacker to steal session tokens and replay them to submit fraudulent claims.
threats.mitigation: Apply Content-Security-Policy headers; sanitize all user-supplied HTML; bind session tokens to client TLS fingerprint.

data.name: API Gateway
data.description: REST API gateway that validates, routes, and authorizes claims from pharmacy operators.

threats.title: Adjudication result tampering via unsecured admin endpoint
threats.description: An insider or compromised service account could modify adjudication outcomes via an unauthenticated internal admin API, altering approved/denied status.

threats.title: PHI leakage through verbose error responses
threats.description: Unhandled exceptions may expose member PHI in HTTP 500 response bodies, violating HIPAA Minimum Necessary.
threats.mitigation: Strip PHI from all error responses; return opaque error codes; ship PHI-containing logs to the internal SIEM only.

data.name: Member Database
data.description: PostgreSQL database storing member eligibility, claim history, and PHI for the PBM platform.

threats.title: Mass PHI exfiltration via SQL injection in eligibility lookup
threats.description: Unsanitized member ID parameters could allow UNION-based SQL injection, exfiltrating SSN, DOB, and prescription history.
threats.mitigation: Parameterize all database queries; apply least privilege to the claims_api role; enable pg_audit logging for SELECT on member tables.

threats.title: Claims database unavailability via unthrottled bulk reprocessing
threats.description: Bulk claim reprocessing requests can saturate the member database connection pool, causing downtime that delays patient medication access.
threats.mitigation: Apply per-pharmacy rate limits at the API gateway; implement connection pool sizing and queue-based backpressure for bulk jobs.
